notes.title: 🌾Grass Cutting Incremental Is Coming To Steam & WAMI - Core System Rework!
notes.content:
[b]We’ve got some massive announcements to share![/b]


[b]🌾Grass Cutting Incremental is coming to Steam, Android, and iOS in partnership with LethalDolphin![/b]

Yes you read that right! We’re beyond excited to officially announce that Oni Gaming will be publishing and porting the legendary Roblox incremental game Grass Cutting Incremental, originally created by LethalDolphin.

This isn’t just a quick port — it's a full rebuild for PC and mobile, with:
[list]
[*] A brand-new UI and design tailored for Steam and mobile platforms.
[*] Touch controls and performance optimization.
[*] New features and systems to elevate the gameplay experience.
[/list]The original creator, LethalDolphin, is actively involved and will supervise the project to ensure the new version stays true to the original spirit while pushing the experience further.

[b]Don’t expect a release before 2026[/b], but we’ll be sharing progress and previews along the way.
We’re hiring for this game, recruitment info at the end.


[b]🟡 WAMI - Core System Rework![/b]

The [b]WAMI spinoff[/b] has undergone a core gameplay overhaul up to the Reincarnation layer.
[list]
[*] Removed outdated content.
[*] Introduced [b]new mechanics[/b].
[*] Laid the groundwork for the final design pass.
[/list]The question now: [b]Which universe will this game take place in?[/b] [i]Any guesses?[/i]


[b]To Our Amazing Community[/b] ❤️

With over 90,000 demons in our Discord, we’re constantly humbled by your passion and support. While many of you are eagerly waiting for new games and features, we want to reaffirm this:
[list]
[*] [b]We will always prioritize quality over quantity.[/b]
[*] Every update, system, and game is built with love, care, and polish to make sure your experience is the best it can be (well, most of the time 😈).
[/list]Thank you for being a part of this journey. [b]More is coming. Stay tuned![/b]

The Oni Gaming Team

notes.title: Update 150 (New Class & More) 20.11.23:
notes.content:
Classes
• New: Your handling of classes, Synergy and Darkness now allows you to handle 2 new classes.But mastering and mastering these will demand a lot from you. (2 master classes have been added, these do NOT work like normal classes).
• Comprehensive information on masterclasses has been added (The ? bottom right).
• Classes can now also level up when they are not active and all at the same time.
• Extended functionality: Beastmaster Active Talent now has 6 levels Unlockable with Stage 800.
• + 5 Adventure Item level (drop) for Endaver Gear this Bonus is Increased to +10 Itemlevel per Drop.

Spirit
• Spirit was limited to 1e300.
• Spirit Refill can handle numbers over 1e308 Shadows.

Shadows
• The Shadows are tired of the countless summons and are more on guard, you now have to make more effort to successfully summon them(the calculation for the number of Shadows has been optimised to avoid errors and performance spikes, it now takes a few seconds until all Shadows are summoned).
• Update rate of the UI has been increased significantly, everything now appears smoother.
• Shadow calculation has been optimised to avoid NaN/Infinity near the spirit cap, also no negative numbers are displayed for the next shadow anymore.
• It can now no longer happen that Shadows are reduced because of the Gathering costs.
• While the shadows are being summoned, 'being summoned' is now displayed instead of a negative number for the spirit required for the next shadow.
• The accuracy has also been increased, which means that you now have 1 - 3 more Shadows than originally intended, which may mean that you will NOT get a new Shadow with the next cost reduction upgrade.
• QoL: Right-clicking on the Shadow display will now also retrieve all Shadows assigned in Darkness.
• No new Shadows can be summoned offline.

Conjuring
• Fixed a rare bug that caused negative numbers to be displayed as current mana.
• The limits for the bonuses have been increased from 1e250 to 1e300 (these will be removed with the next patch).

Arena
• QoL: The arena can now also level up outside of battles to reduce accumulated arena exp.

SynV2
• Page 3 has been revised.
• Due to the massive changes, page 3 has been reset and all previous purchases refunded.
• QoL: If the purchase button is held down, further levels are purchased automatically after a short delay.
• Potion Convergence now works differently, instead of increasing the bonus that potions grant, it now adds a perma bonus based on the highest stage ever reached when using potions, proportional to the duration of the potions used.The bonus can be viewed in the Soulshop under Potions and in the upgrade info. (further and more detailed information is available at the bottom right of ?).
• Antigravity Convergence now grants a permanent bonus to Antigravity Boost instead of a one-time increase.
• Spiritual Convergence has been renamed Mastery Convergence and now also has a use -Unlockable with Stage 830.

Dungeon
• Fixed a bug that displayed incorrect values for the bonus increase for a completed floor.

Generator
• Fixed a bug that did not correctly grant the mana power bonus.

Darkness
• Dark Matter Refill Info Box: no longer shows negative duration while offline time is being processed, and now shows this better.
• Antigravity is now limited to 150babyshadows and all accumulated exp has been set to 0.

Darkness Shop Page 2
• Page 2 has been completely revised all purchased upgrades except BD Demon Reduce have been reset, the costs refunded and revised.
• All tooltips now show the exact bonus increase for the next level.
• When the maximum of an upgrade has been reached, this is now displayed more clearly.
• New: Battle Singularity - Increases the price reduction of the SynV2 upgrades Arena/ Necromantic Convergence multiplicatively!Total bonuses will be displayed for the respective upgrades in the SynV2 Shop.
• Extended functionality: Dark Matter Singularity: Every 10 levels the bonus is increased by 10 % (rounded up) up to a maximum of 50 % at level 50.
• Extended functionality: Arena Singularity: Every 10 levels the malus is reduced by 0.08(approx. 12 - 17 %) for each additional active skill(does not work if only one skill is active).
• Extended functionality Converter Singularity: The bonus is increased by 10% every 100 levels.
• Extended functionality: Slime Lab Singularity: Per level the speed is increased by 0.1 %, the levels by 1.5x and the costs by 2x.
• Singularity Reverbation: now only reduces the cost of Black Holes (note: the price / curve has generally been lowered and the buffs are now more rewarding at the beginning).
• Endaver Singularity: Has been removed and is now a talent of the BeastMaster (Note: The upgrade will eventually become redundant and does not justify the cost).

SoulShop Potions
• The texts have been corrected and improved.
• The active term for a Potion has been limited to 30 days.
• The active bonuses should now be granted correctly as soon as the offline calculations are completed..
• Tooltips have been improved and now also show the passive bonuses.
• Potions now have a soft cap that is reached at Stage 2000.
